name: Rogue Talents
_unconfirmed: feat: whether the Feat advanced talent may be taken more than once; the CRB says no talent may be taken twice and the Feat entry does not state an exception, so 'repeatable' is omitted

rules.sneak_attack_limit: Only one talent marked sneak_attack may apply to a given attack, chosen before the roll.
rules.no_repeats: A talent cannot be taken twice unless it says otherwise.

options.name: Bleeding Attack
options.text: Your sneak attacks open wounds that bleed each round for as many points as you have sneak attack dice.

options.name: Combat Trick
options.text: You gain one bonus combat feat.

options.name: Fast Stealth
options.text: You can move at full speed while using Stealth with no penalty.

options.name: Finesse Rogue
options.text: You gain Weapon Finesse as a bonus feat.

options.name: Ledge Walker
options.text: You cross narrow surfaces at full speed with Acrobatics and stay ready to defend while doing so.

options.name: Minor Magic
options.text: Pick a 0-level sorcerer/wizard spell; cast it three times a day as a spell-like ability.

options.name: Major Magic
options.text: Pick a 1st-level sorcerer/wizard spell; cast it twice a day as a spell-like ability.

options.name: Quick Disable
options.text: Disabling a trap takes you half the usual time.

options.name: Resiliency
options.text: Once a day, when dropped below 0 hit points, gain temporary hit points equal to your rogue level for a minute.

options.name: Rogue Crawl
options.text: You can crawl at half speed while prone, even taking a 5-foot step.

options.name: Slow Reactions
options.text: Foes hurt by your sneak attack cannot make attacks of opportunity for 1 round.

options.name: Stand Up
options.text: You rise from prone as a free action, though doing so still provokes as usual.

options.name: Surprise Attack
options.text: In a surprise round, foes count as flat-footed to you even if they have already acted.

options.name: Trap Spotter
options.text: Coming within 10 feet of a trap earns you an automatic, secret Perception check to notice it.

options.name: Weapon Training
options.text: You gain Weapon Focus as a bonus feat.

options.name: Crippling Strike
options.text: Your sneak attacks also deal 2 points of Strength damage.

options.name: Defensive Roll
options.text: Once a day, against a blow that would drop you to 0 or less, a Reflex save halves the damage.

options.name: Dispelling Attack
options.text: Sneak attack damage also targets the foe with dispel magic against its lowest-level active spell.

options.name: Feat
options.text: Take any feat you qualify for instead of a talent.

options.name: Improved Evasion
options.text: As evasion, and you now take only half damage even when the Reflex save fails.

options.name: Opportunist
options.text: Once a round, take an attack of opportunity against a foe an ally has just hit in melee.

options.name: Skill Mastery
options.text: Choose 3 + Int modifier skills; you can always take 10 on them, even under stress.

options.name: Slippery Mind
options.text: After failing a save against an enchantment, you get one more save a round later at the same DC.
